Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 81: March 2008
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #81 shipped to subscribers in February 2008 (bearing the cover date of March 2008 for Issue 81). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #81 delivered a spring slate of high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, and exclusive media content:

Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Vegas 2 (tactical squad-based FPS)
Army of Two (co-op tactical third-person shooter)
SEGA Superstars Tennis (arcade crossover sports)
Triggerheart Exelica (Xbox Live Arcade vertical shoot 'em up)
Bionic Commando Rearmed (Xbox Live Arcade classic 2.5D action remaster)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc delivered custom downloadable dashboard themes and gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—including featurettes for Grand Theft Auto IV, Ninja Gaiden II, Gears of War 2, and Fable II, alongside OXM's monthly Top Plays segment.
